title: Build of AAPS 3.2.0.4 fails
body:

comments.body:
Okay. I used the flatpak version of AndroidStudio and I always got the same error. (It did work for years without issues!)

I installed the native AndroidStudio from the repos (Arch Linux) and with that one it did work immediately. 

Sorry for the confusion.
